rationale: council is the concept/decision-guide (convene a four-voice council for ambiguous decisions); council_runner is the executor (stage orchestration, result aggregation for the Council of Five). They are functionally distinct — merging would collapse the concept/execution separation. Delegate: council keeps the bare 'council' trigger; council_runner receives more specific 'run council' and 'council runner' triggers so the executor is only invoked when the user explicitly wants deliberation executed.
actions_taken: Removed bare trigger 'council' from council_runner in ROUTE_REGISTRY.json
Removed trigger entry {pattern:'council', skill:'council_runner'} from TRIGGER_REGISTRY.json
Added trigger 'run council' -> council_runner (functional, 0.8) to TRIGGER_REGISTRY.json
Added trigger 'council runner' -> council_runner (functional, 0.8) to TRIGGER_REGISTRY.json
